author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The MacBook Neo is a great deal in many respects: excellent build quality, nice screen, long battery life, and enough juice to make it a productivity monster.  But it can also emulation nearly every retro (and modern) system available.  Let's test it out!

More info: https://www.apple.com/macbook-neo
